response.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS telescope_share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Include observatory stations with no telescopes, reporting a count and share of zero; ties at the tenth station may be chosen arbitrarily.
